IKU REMO tells the story of Ramoni Elewure, a mysterious, highly spiritual, and feared man who destroys anyone that stands in his way. Though he appears as a young man, he possesses the spirit and mindset of a newborn child trapped in an adult body.

Ramoni lives with his two wives, who are spiritually powerful elderly women. However, everything changes the day he finally encounters his biological mother. Hidden secrets, spiritual battles, destiny, and family mysteries unfold, leading to shocking revelations that will change his life forever.
